The instant application is filed under Section 5 of the Limitation Act read with Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure on behalf of the appellant, seeking condonation of delay in filing of the appeal.
For the sufficient cause being shown in the applications, the same is allowed and the delay of 59 days in filing the appeal is condoned.
